mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and may compete for CYP3A4, with ibuprofen potentially increasing ivermectin plasma concentrations; additionally, NSAIDs can impair renal function affecting drug clearance.
action: Monitor for ivermectin toxicity signs (neurotoxicity, dizziness); use lowest effective NSAID dose and shortest duration; ensure adequate renal function; consider alternative analgesics if prolonged ivermectin therapy required.
